'''Tecknel Shnick''' was a member of the criminal underworld on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

{{RPGseed}} 
In [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]]'s "[[The Grand Design|Grand Design]]" [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] he once hired a [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] crew to transport fourteen large crates to [[Gesaril]]. Unbeknownst to the hired crew, the crates were destined to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and contained high-tech equipment for [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]]. The crates were retrieved by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Tor Skylow]] feigning a boarding.<ref name="GG6-1" />
{{Endgame}}
